sources.title: My First Flybar Offers a Kid-Safe Intro to Pogo Stick Bouncing Fun

sources.title: My First Flybar
sources.snippet: Great for indoor and outdoor use and won't scratch surfaces. Made for toddlers 3+ and up, My First Flybar can hold up to 250lbs., making it fun for adults too!
